ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites: AE 311, AE 312, MATH 285 3 hours for undergrads and 4 hours for graduate students Possible Topics: Governing Equations, Linearized Flows/Analytical Techniques, Taylor-Maccoll Flow Over a Cone, Steady Supersonic Flow by the Method of Characteristics, Time-Dependent Method for Steady and Unsteady Flows in All Speed Regimes, Compressible Boundary Layers, Compressible Shear Layers, Compressible Separated Flows, Shock Wave/Boundary Layer Interactions [Not all these topics can be covered.]
